evidence_definitions.resource_definition: Parsed local J460 EntityConfig or ANM2 resource.
evidence_definitions.static_call_relation: Direct call or data-flow relation in the local PE.
evidence_definitions.runtime_identity_probe: Exact NPC identity observed in the recompiled original engine.
evidence_definitions.runtime_callback_index: NPC update/action or attack-object evidence in the historical engine callback index.
evidence_definitions.source_linked_cooccurrence: Spawner/Parent pointer and a 0/1-frame action/object relation; correlation only.
evidence_definitions.offline_code_test: Native C++ unit/regression test over synthetic state.
evidence_definitions.external_live_read: ReadProcessMemory observation from the running game process.
evidence_definitions.pre_attack_live_external_validated: Live external observation proves the warning before the dangerous entity or hit exists.

capability_levels.1_attack_logic_exists: Static code or resource evidence exists.
capability_levels.2_enemy_possesses_attack: Runtime action/object evidence exists for the exact identity.
capability_levels.3_current_attack_state_readable: External fields expose state/animation/timers, but per-enemy semantics must be confirmed.
capability_levels.4_pre_attack_identified: A specific state/timer rule identifies windup before danger.
capability_levels.5_danger_region_and_reaction_time: The rule computes geometry and timing and has matching runtime validation.
